fair_value_reason: 70%: 16x NTM-at-horizon EPS of about $3.80 (11/12 FY28 + 1/12 FY29; FY27 $3.34 consensus, FY28 +13.5% extrapolated, no FY28 consensus) = $60.8. 20%: 16.2x (10% under the 18x core median) x CY27 $3.49 = $56.5, rolled forward at 10% = $62.2. 10%: EV cross-check with corrected inputs (66.0M as-converted shares incl. 8.7M exchange shares; net debt $76M; about $75M of excess value on remaining converts), about $55.5. supervisor_summary: PENG at $61.36 trades at about 17.6x CY27 EPS of about $3.49, roughly at a reconciled core peer median of about 18x. The agents' 19-20.5x rested on a stale JBL estimate (it is 15.9x, not about 18.5x) and non-comparable NTAP/PLXS/TTMI. Fair value is about $60.5 on 16x NTM-at-horizon EPS. Two round-1 facts I gave the agents were wrong and all five copied them: net debt is about $76M, not $175M (the 2030 notes were $200M), and the July exchange issued about 8.7M shares, so EV methods need about 66M as-converted shares. Round-2 convergence is therefore largely anchoring. I keep the mean ladder except for a modest restoration of the right tail, and the Oct-6 print is a two-way event. Defense exposure is about 0.2% of sales (DoD only), not material.

Interim CFO since 2026-07-09 and negative working-capital cash flow.
